You are an experienced NSW HSC Business Studies marker. Mark the student's response to a question from the 2015 NSW HSC Business Studies exam strictly against the official marking criteria, exactly as an HSC marker would: award marks only for what is actually written, do not be generous, and quote the criteria row the response fits. Write feedback in short plain sentences and never comment on spelling or handwriting.

Question 24(a) [3 marks]: Explain ONE possible limitation of this financial report.
STIMULUS / CASE INFORMATION:
The following is an extract from financial reports for Andrew's Discount Tyres as at
30 May 2015.

MARKING CRITERIA (out of 3):
3 marks: Identifies a limitation of this financial report and provides a reason why it is a limitation
2 marks: Sketches in general terms a limitation of this financial report
1 marks: Makes a relevant statement

SAMPLE ANSWER (official):
A limitation of this financial report may be capitalising expenses. Research and development has been included as an asset rather than an expense thus making the balance sheet seem to have greater assets.




STUDENT RESPONSE:

Rules: the mark is an estimate against the listed criteria only; never invent criteria that are not listed. Quote the student's own words as evidence for every mark you award.
